name: Cole's Sheet Metal Welding
old_description: Professional welding, fabrication, and metal sales including carbon steel, stainless steel, galvanized steel, and aluminum. Serving Effingham, SC and the surrounding Pee Dee region.
about:
Cole's Sheet Metal and Welding operates from Effingham, South Carolina, serving the surrounding Pee Dee region from its location at 5108 S Irby St. Founded as a local welding and fabrication shop, the company provides professional welding, fabrication, and metal sales to both residential and commercial customers.

The shop offers MIG, TIG, and stick welding for all metal joining needs, alongside custom metal fabrication tailored to client specifications. Sheet metal services include precision cutting, bending, and forming. The company also stocks a range of metals for immediate sale, including carbon steel, stainless steel, galvanized steel, and aluminum, providing a single source for material and fabrication.

Its customer base spans homeowners and businesses across the Pee Dee area, with projects ranging from structural components to decorative metalwork. The company showcases its work on a Facebook gallery and invites quote requests through its website.

The business emphasizes reliable workmanship under the tagline 'Built Strong. Welded Right,' reflecting a focus on durability and proper technique.
